output.title: Is there a fee to file an appeal?
output.draft_text:
Question: Is there a fee to file an appeal?

Answer: [Yes/No], there [is/is not] a fee to file an appeal. [If a fee applies: The fee is [fee amount], and it is paid by [payment method] at [point in the appeal process when payment is due]. [Fee waiver or refund conditions, if any].]

This applies to [types of appeals covered, e.g., internal appeals, external reviews, pharmacy coverage appeals]. [If different appeal levels have different fee rules, describe each level and its fee.]

To file an appeal, the member can [how to submit an appeal, e.g., phone, mail, online portal, fax] within [number of days] of [triggering event, e.g., the date on the denial notice]. [Any required documents or information.]

If you have questions about your appeal, contact [contact channel and hours].

author_checklist: Confirm whether any fee is charged to file an appeal, citing the governing plan document or regulation.
If a fee exists, confirm the amount, payment method, timing, and any waiver or refund conditions.
Confirm whether the fee answer differs by appeal level (internal appeal vs. external review) or by plan type, line of business, or state.
Confirm which appeal types this unit covers (medical, pharmacy, eligibility, etc.) and whether separate units are needed.
Confirm the appeal filing deadline and the event that starts the clock.
Confirm the accepted submission channels and any required documents.
Confirm the correct contact channel and hours for appeal questions.
Have legal/compliance review the wording, since appeal rights may be governed by regulation.
Confirm the correct knowledge base for this unit (benefits vs. pharmacy vs. shared-legal).
Remove any bracketed conditional sections that do not apply before approval.
